resources.string: Zenlygram is free software (GPL). The link to its source code will appear here.
It is not affiliated with Telegram FZ-LLC and connects to the Telegram network through the official API.
Shows, greyed out, the rows of features that are not ported to Android yet, to check the layout. Debug builds only.
Greyed rows belong to features that are not in this build yet and can\'t be used. To hide them, turn off “%1$s” in %2$s at the bottom.

Choose one of your Telegram contacts.
Changes the date and keeps the time. Applied when you save.
This date can\'t be saved. Pick a date between 1970 and 2038.
Tasks with a deadline on this day appear here. Pick another day or switch to List.
Tasks without a deadline appear here. Pick a day to see tasks due then.
No lists yet. Tap “+” to create one.
This will delete the list. This cannot be undone.

This will delete the list and its %1$d tasks. This cannot be undone.
Keeps a copy of messages that others delete and marks it with 🗑. Stored only on this device and removed automatically after 30 days.
Saves earlier versions of edited messages on this device only: up to 20 per message, each deleted after 30 days. Open with long press → Edit History. Turning this off deletes saved versions.
No earlier versions of this message are saved on this device.

Telegram doesn\'t say who deleted a message, so in private chats and small groups messages you delete for yourself on another device may also be kept. Not kept: your own messages, Saved Messages, service and self-destructing messages, deletions that also remove your messages (like clearing a chat), and chats where you can delete others\' messages. At most 5,000 messages are kept per account. Clearing Telegram\'s cache also permanently removes the media of kept messages, and Clear Local Database (Data and Storage → Storage Usage) or a long time offline permanently removes the kept messages themselves. Long-press a kept message → Delete to remove it. Turning this off deletes all kept messages.
This call uses TCP. Call quality may be lower.

Forgot it? Use the option below.
The code couldn\'t be checked. Try again.
Biometrics changed on this device. Enter your pincode.
Use a fingerprint or face enrolled on this device instead of typing the pincode. The pincode keeps working.
A face or fingerprint was added or removed on this device after this pincode was set. Keep using biometrics here, or unlock with the pincode only?
Unlocks this chat and removes its pincode
Turns off Chat Lock and unlocks all chats
It opens any locked chat whose pincode you forget.
Use biometrics to unlock this chat
Use biometrics to turn off Chat Lock
This removes the master pincode and unlocks every chat. Your messages are not deleted.
Confirm your identity to reset Chat Lock

Resetting Chat Lock needs proof that this device is yours: unchanged biometrics or a screen lock. Set a screen lock in Android Settings and try again, or turn Chat Lock off in Zenlygram settings with your master pincode. Your messages are never lost.
The fingerprints or faces on this device changed after the master pincode was set, so they can\'t stand in for it. Confirm with your screen lock to reset Chat Lock. Your messages are not deleted.
Chat Lock needs a new pincode

The pincodes of locked chats can\'t be checked on this device any more. The chats stay locked until you set one new pincode for all of them or turn Chat Lock off. Both need your screen lock. Your messages are not deleted.
Set a new pincode for locked chats
Confirm your identity to restore Chat Lock
This device has no screen lock, so nothing else can confirm it is yours. Turning Chat Lock off unlocks all chats. Your messages are not deleted.
Chat Lock is on. Select a chat in the list and choose Set Pincode in the ⋮ menu.
Chat Lock is off. All chats are unlocked.
Couldn\'t save the pincode. Try again.
This chat will appear in your chat list again.
Couldn\'t hide the chat. Try again.
Couldn\'t save the change. Try again.
This device can\'t keep the vault\'s protected storage right now, so the Secret Vault can\'t be turned on. Try again later.
Chats you hide will appear here and stay out of your main list.
To open the vault, press and hold the app name at the top of your chat list.
Use biometrics to recover access to hidden chats
Opens the Secret Vault instead of the vault PIN
Enter the vault PIN to turn the Secret Vault on again
Turns off the Secret Vault and shows all hidden chats again
Secret Vault is off. All hidden chats are back in your chat list.

This device no longer has what it takes to check the saved vault PIN, so even the right one is refused. Set a new vault PIN to use the vault again — your hidden chats stay hidden. This needs your screen lock. Your messages are untouched.
Secret Vault needs a new PIN

This device lost the key that protected the list of hidden chats, so those chats are visible again. Set a new vault PIN to use the vault again, or turn it off. Both need your screen lock. Your messages are untouched.
Confirm your identity to restore the Secret Vault
This device has no screen lock, so nothing else can confirm it is yours. Continue? Your messages are not deleted.

The vault PIN can\'t be recovered on this device. It is a lock inside this app, and the device screen lock is never accepted for it: only the biometrics enrolled when the PIN was set, or a Chat Lock master pincode that already existed then, can stand in for it. If neither works, the only way to remove the vault is to log out of that Telegram account in Zenlygram and log in again (or to reinstall the app). The hidden chats then come back, but this also deletes that account\'s secret chats on this device and the deleted and edited messages Zenlygram has kept. Your cloud chats stay on Telegram.
The vault PIN can\'t be checked right now. Unlock this device, wait a moment and try again.
The Secret Vault can\'t be used on this device until it gets a new PIN. Tap Secret Vault to restore it or turn it off. Your messages are not affected.
No way to recover this PIN

This phone has no fingerprint (or other strong biometric) set up, and Chat Lock has no master pincode. If you forget the vault PIN, nothing in the app can open the vault or turn it off. Keep the PIN somewhere safe, or first add a fingerprint in the phone\'s settings or set up Chat Lock.
Also switches the chat list to two lines.
When off, swiping the list switches folders.
Show the panel with the mute button at the bottom of channels you have joined. The Join button always stays.
Side buttons (share, AI summary, Quick Translate) move to the message menu: long-press a post.
Hide the bottom tab bar. Contacts, Calls, Settings, your profile and accounts move to the ⋮ menu of the chat list, and so does Tasks while its tab is shown.
Show the Calls tab in the tab bar, in place of the Settings tab. Settings is then in the ⋮ menu of the chat list. Applies to the current account (Telegram\'s own setting).
Reduces the spacing between folder tabs so more folders fit.
Enter sends the message. On a hardware keyboard, Shift+Enter adds a new line. This is the same option as \"Send by Enter\" in Telegram\'s Chat Settings.
Show \"Save to gallery\" for photos and videos in the message menu.
Only the latest %1$d loaded messages can be selected at once.
No other loaded messages from this author.
Couldn\'t show this message as JSON.
There is no automatic fallback to another service. Without Telegram Premium, whole-chat translation needs %1$s.

Quick translation and whole-chat translation (with the pinned message and quoted replies) send the text from your device to Google Translate. The Translate window in the message menu uses Telegram, and Google Translate only where Telegram can\'t translate.
Telegram can\'t translate messages here. To translate them, choose %1$s in Zenlygram settings → Translate Messages → Service.

Show a translate button next to incoming messages; tap it again to see the original. Wide channel posts have it in the message menu. Not offered in secret chats, for copy-protected messages or for kept copies of deleted messages (one translated before the deletion can still be switched back).

Hides private chats whose phone country code differs from your own, only in the All Chats list: folders, the archive and search still show them. Local visual filter only — it never blocks anyone and can\'t hide people who hide their phone number.
Approves everyone who asks to join, in every group and channel where you can add members, on all your logged-in accounts. Turn it off to review requests yourself.
You have %1$d unread message. Don\'t forget to check it.
You have %1$d unread messages. Don\'t forget to check them.
Notifications are turned off for Zenlygram, so the reminder can\'t be shown.
This video cannot be converted to a round video on this device.
As in the official app: where Telegram can\'t translate itself, the text may go to Google Translate. To never use Google, choose \"%1$s\". Without Telegram Premium, whole-chat translation needs %2$s.

Adds Zenlygram\'s items to the message menu (Save to Cloud, Select from Author, JSON and more); the items you switch off below go to a \"Zenlygram\" sub-menu. Off: none of these items. Edit History, Add to Tasks and the items of deleted messages and wide posts follow their own settings.
In a chat, open the attachment menu, select one video, then long-press Send and choose \"Send as Round Video\". Not offered for a video with a caption, a price, a spoiler, a cover or edits.
Show the Tasks tab in the tab bar. Hiding it also removes \"Add to Tasks\" from the message menu and Tasks from the ⋮ menu; your tasks are kept and still open from Tasks under Tools below.
Show folders as a bar at the bottom.
Reopen the last used folder on launch.
Hide the All Chats folder tab.
Developer options are now shown at the bottom of this screen.
A round video can\'t have a caption, a price, a spoiler, a cover or edits. Remove them to send this video as a round video.
With the selected service, Telegram doesn\'t translate messages for this account, so the Quick Translate button can\'t appear. To use it, choose %1$s in Service above.
